facts.text: I am planning to plant new flowers in my garden.
I ordered new gardening tools online, including a trowel and pruners, on January 20th.
I am thinking of planting peas alongside my tomatoes.
I built a new trellis for the peas using leftover wood from my husband's project.
I set up a soaker hose and irrigation system to make watering easier.
I bought a bag of compost from the local nursery on February 5th.
I am planning to check the soil pH to make sure it is suitable for my tomatoes and peas.
